verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs state it offers official client libraries for several programming languages for its API (gusto-docs-54). It also ships an official React SDK, a component library with built-in payroll business logic (gusto-docs-53, gusto-docs-65). Versioned API headers and per-version Postman collections support this (gusto-docs-67, gusto-docs-68), but the pack gives only one-line mentions of the client libraries. Missing for 10: the specific SDK languages, install/usage depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
